8C3Z-6A642-AEngine Oil Cooler 8C3Z-6A642-A for Ford
AG9G6S642BCEngine Oil Cooler AG9G6S642BC / /LR025515 for Ford
H6BG-6B856-DAEngine Oil Cooler H6BG-6B856-DA for Ford
HX7G-6B856-AAEngine Oil Cooler HX7G-6B856-AA for Ford
//J7BG-7J389-ABEngine Oil Cooler //J7BG-7J389-AB for Ford

The table shows why exact character handling matters. For example, 3C3Z-6A642-CA and 3C3Z-6A642-CA/R are separate catalogue entries, while H6BG-6B856-DA and HX7G-6B856-AA carry different suffixes. Distributors should avoid normalizing these references in spreadsheets, ERP records, or purchase orders.

Several product pages provide direct catalogue details for individual references. These include the HX7G-6B856-AA Ford engine oil cooler, the 1S7E-6A642-CC Ford engine oil cooler, and the 3C3Z-6A642-CA Ford engine oil cooler. The 6790424780 Ford engine oil cooler is also listed as a separate aluminium product.

Vehicle Fitment

Ford is the stated vehicle application across the catalogue entries. BB3Q-6B624-EA additionally carries RANGE in its fitment line, while its part name is written as Engine Oil Cooler BB3Q-6B624-EA for Ford / RANGE. This distinction should be retained in the item record rather than flattening the entry into a generic Ford-only description.

Vehicle fitment is not the same as universal interchangeability. No model years, engine codes, transmission types, or installation positions are provided in the facts. Importers should therefore request a vehicle identification check using their own part requirement and supplied OE number before ordering. The quoted catalogue application is a starting point for matching, not a substitute for confirming the buyer’s actual application.

For distributors carrying several references, a useful intake process is to photograph the OE marking, record the full vehicle application from the request, and preserve the original characters in the internal record. For a grouped item such as 7S7G-6B856A4A / /1925463 / /1778546, retain all three strings and clarify which reference appears on the physical part before approval.

Fitment confirmation also protects receiving operations. If the marking, product description, or recorded application does not match the purchase order, quarantine the item for review rather than placing it into general inventory. This control reduces the risk that two visually similar oil coolers become mixed under an incorrect SKU.

Where a buyer’s request includes an application not shown in the catalogue facts, the mismatch should be resolved before the order is released. The appropriate response is to retain the quoted Ford application and request additional identification from the buyer. It is not appropriate to infer model, engine, or installation compatibility from the shape of the component.

Pricing, MOQ and Lead Time

Commercial terms are standardized across the listed catalogue products. The minimum order quantity is MOQ 10 pieces. Pricing is FOB quotation on request, with a quotation lead time of 1 business day for quotation. The catalogue uses RFQ supply status, so requests should include the exact OE number, required quantity, destination, and any buyer-specific packing or documentation requirements.

For a mixed multi-reference request, list each OE number on a separate line and identify the required quantity for every reference. This approach prevents grouped references from being mistaken for separate quantities. If one line contains 7S7G-6B856A4A / /1925463 / /1778546, confirm whether the request is for one catalogue variant represented by three references or for multiple units.

All linked products are described as aluminium and carry a 12-month warranty. These listed attributes can be included in the RFQ, but the final commercial offer should confirm the part, quantity, FOB basis, and quotation details in writing. No stock status is confirmed by the catalogue, so the enquiry should not be based on an assumption of immediate dispatch.

A useful RFQ structure includes the part name, exact OE number, Ford application where applicable, RANGE only for BB3Q-6B624-EA, quantity, destination, and requested packing details. Buyers should also request confirmation of the 12-month warranty terms applicable to the quoted order.

For grouped identifiers, retain the catalogue relationship in the request rather than selecting one reference and discarding the others without clarification. For example, the AG9G6S642BC and /LR025515 records refer to the same listed product, while 7S7G-6B856A4A, /1925463, and /1778546 are also grouped. Quantity allocation should be stated clearly at the product and OE-reference level.

Common Failure Signs

An engine oil cooler should be evaluated for condition as carefully as its identity. Look for visible cracks, deformation, damaged mounting areas, and leakage around connection points. Inspect the sealing surfaces and bundled parts without applying unlisted installation assumptions. Any damage found during opening should be documented before the unit enters inventory.

Obstruction or contamination is another practical concern. Examine the visible passages for evidence of blocked or damaged areas and check that the component is clean. The catalogue facts do not provide a pressure-test procedure, flow-rate specification, or internal cleanliness standard for these products, so buyers should not invent acceptance values. If a measurable inspection is required, specify it separately in the RFQ or purchase documentation.

Identification errors can resemble sourcing failures. An incorrect suffix, incomplete slash prefix, or transposed character can place an otherwise similar cooler under the wrong OE record. Compare the complete marking against the catalogue reference without dropping characters such as // in //J7BG-7J389-AB or changing AG9G6S642BC into a differently formatted reference.

Distributors should also monitor repeat discrepancies across receiving, warranty, and returns records. If the same reference is repeatedly misidentified, review packaging labels, internal ERP fields, and the receiving procedure. The objective is to eliminate transcription variation without changing the factory-style OE references.

Separately, a damaged or contaminated unit should not be accepted solely because its marking matches the purchase order. Identity and condition are separate checks. Record both the exact OE number and the observed condition, and keep unresolved units apart from accepted inventory while the discrepancy is reviewed.

Quality Checklist

Before approving a shipment, verify the part name and complete OE marking against the purchase order. Check that the recorded application is Ford, except where RANGE is specifically associated with BB3Q-6B624-EA. Confirm that the ordered quantity meets MOQ 10 pieces and that the quotation clearly states FOB quotation on request.

Inspect the aluminium cooler for transport damage, contamination, blocked visible passages, damaged connections, and defects at the sealing areas. Compare the unit’s marking with the catalogue identification. Photograph the packaging and the part marking for traceability, then record the inspection result against the OE number without abbreviating or normalizing it.

For grouped references, verify that the purchase order preserves the complete grouping: 7S7G-6B856A4A / /1925463 / /1778546 or AG9G6S642BC / /LR025515. For the //J7BG-7J389-AB entry, retain the full catalogue description, Engine Oil Cooler //J7BG-7J389-AB for Ford, in the item master and receiving documentation.

The catalogue product 8C3Z-6A642-A Ford engine oil cooler and the 7S7G-6B856A4A Ford engine oil cooler show how separate catalogue records can be used to verify identifiers before an order is released. The quotation should also state the 1 business day quotation lead time and confirm the documented 12-month warranty.

Finally, keep the inspection record with the receiving documents and label each unit or carton with its exact OE number. Separate unresolved items from accepted inventory. This is especially important for visually similar references such as HX7G-6B856-AA and H6BG-6B856-DA, where character-level accuracy is more reliable than general appearance.

A practical approval sequence is to match the OE string, confirm the catalogue part description, verify the stated vehicle application, inspect visible condition, reconcile the received quantity with the purchase order, and retain supporting photographs. Any discrepancy should remain documented against the exact reference that was received.

FAQ

What is the minimum order quantity for a Ford engine oil cooler?

The MOQ is 10 pieces for the listed engine oil cooler products. Each RFQ should state the exact OE number and required quantity.

How is the price quoted?

The price is an FOB quotation on request. The catalogue quotation lead time is 1 business day for quotation, with the quotation requested through an RFQ.

Are H6BG-6B856-DA and HX7G-6B856-AA the same OE reference?

No. H6BG-6B856-DA and HX7G-6B856-AA are separate OE numbers with separate catalogue product pages. The full suffix must be checked during sourcing and receiving.

Which fitment is listed for BB3Q-6B624-EA?

BB3Q-6B624-EA is listed as Engine Oil Cooler BB3Q-6B624-EA for Ford / RANGE. Its record includes both Ford and RANGE, so both should be retained.

Can /1925463 be listed by itself?

The catalogue associates /1925463 with Engine Oil Cooler 7S7G-6B856A4A / /1925463 for Ford and groups it with 7S7G-6B856A4A and /1778546. Confirm the full reference and the physical marking before ordering.

What material is stated for the linked engine oil coolers?

The linked catalogue products specify aluminium material. Confirm the applicable product specification again when the quotation is issued.

What should be checked when the oil coolers arrive?

Check the full OE marking, product description, Ford fitment, and RANGE where applicable. Also inspect for cracks, deformation, leakage, damaged connections, contamination, and blocked visible passages.

How should //J7BG-7J389-AB be recorded?

Record it exactly as //J7BG-7J389-AB in the RFQ, purchase order, inventory record, and receiving documentation. The associated catalogue description is Engine Oil Cooler //J7BG-7J389-AB for Ford.

What warranty is listed for the catalogue products?

The listed engine oil cooler products carry a 12-month warranty. Request confirmation of the applicable warranty terms in the quotation.

title: Hyundai and Kia Wheel Bearing OE Cross-Reference Guide
description: A practical Hyundai and Kia wheel bearing wholesale guide covering OE cross-references, fitment, identification, MOQ, pricing, and sourcing checks.
content:
What This Guide Covers

This guide provides a structured OE-number reference for Hyundai and Kia wheel bearing sourcing. It covers 11 catalogue numbers linked to wheel bearing and front wheel hub bearing product groups, including 40210-ZP50A, 43550-42030, 51720-1G000, 51720-2B000, 51720-2H000, 51720-2S000, 51720-3W000, 51720-A7000, 44300-SNA-A02, 527202P000, and 8L8Z-1104-A. Eight of these numbers have published OE detail pages that can be used during cross-checking.

The information is intended for parts importers, distributors, and purchasing teams that need to compare an OE number with the corresponding catalogue product before requesting a commercial quotation. It also explains the fitment distinctions between the general wheel bearing listing and the two front hub bearing groups associated with the Elantra, Cerato, i30, Tucson, ix35, and Sportage.

Wheel bearing identification should be based on the complete OE number, product configuration, and vehicle application together. An OE number alone should not replace a physical or packaging check because catalogue records group several references within related product families. The correct sequence is to verify the number, confirm the product category, compare the specifications, and then request a quotation with the required SKU quantity clearly stated.

How to Identify the Right Part

Begin with the OE number printed on the bearing, hub, package, or parts documentation. Preserve every character, including hyphens, spacing, and letter suffixes. For example, the suffix in 51720-A7000 must not be shortened, while the full form of 51720-2H000 must be matched as written. Searching by only the first six characters can create confusion across multiple catalogue references.

Next, distinguish the general Hyundai and Kia wheel bearing catalogue from the front hub assemblies used in specific vehicle groups. The general product page lists 43550-42030, 44300-SNA-A02, 40210-ZP50A, and 8L8Z-1104-A. Its listed specifications include an IP68 double seal, an integrated ABS tone ring on Gen 3 units, factory-set preload, and an angular contact, tapered, Gen 3 hub design.

For compact models, compare the front wheel hub bearing for Hyundai Elantra and Kia Cerato. The catalogue associates this product with 51720-1G000, 51720-2H000, and 51720-A7000. It is described as a double-row angular contact unit with an integrated magnetic encoder ABS ring, a maintenance-free sealed design, and high-temperature pre-filled grease.

For the SUV group, compare the front wheel hub bearing for Hyundai Tucson and Kia Sportage. The listed references are 51720-2S000, 51720-3W000, and 51720-2B000. The product is described as a double-row angular contact unit with an integrated ABS ring, a maintenance-free seal, and compatibility with both 2WD and AWD applications.

Physical confirmation should include the hub flange, mounting geometry, ABS ring arrangement, seal construction, and overall configuration. These checks help prevent a general wheel bearing from being selected for a hub-bearing application. Any mismatch between the requested OE number, packaging, and fitted configuration should be resolved before shipment is arranged.

OE Number Cross-Reference

The following cross-reference table groups the catalogue numbers by the product name used in the fitment records. Use the complete OE number as written when preparing an inquiry. Published OE pages can provide an additional reference point for eight entries, while three numbers are included in the catalogue without a published OE detail page.

OE NumberPart Name
40210-ZP50AWheel Bearing
43550-42030Wheel Bearing
51720-1G000Front Wheel Hub Bearing – Hyundai Elantra / Kia Cerato / i30
51720-2B000Front Wheel Hub Bearing – Hyundai Tucson / ix35 / Kia Sportage
51720-2H000Front Wheel Hub Bearing – Hyundai Elantra / Kia Cerato / i30
51720-2S000Front Wheel Hub Bearing – Hyundai Tucson / ix35 / Kia Sportage
51720-3W000Front Wheel Hub Bearing – Hyundai Tucson / ix35 / Kia Sportage
51720-A7000Front Wheel Hub Bearing – Hyundai Elantra / Kia Cerato / i30
44300-SNA-A02Wheel Bearing
527202P000Wheel Bearing
8L8Z-1104-AWheel Bearing

For a direct catalogue check, review OE 40210-ZP50A wheel bearing details and OE 43550-42030 wheel bearing details. Each published page identifies the corresponding part as a wheel bearing with Hyundai and Kia fitment. The product grouping should then be confirmed against the exact application.

The compact-model hub references also have dedicated records: OE 51720-1G000 hub bearing details, OE 51720-2H000 hub bearing details, and OE 51720-A7000 hub bearing details. These entries share the Hyundai Elantra, Kia Cerato, and i30 fitment description.

For the SUV group, use OE 51720-2B000 hub bearing details, OE 51720-2S000 hub bearing details, and OE 51720-3W000 hub bearing details. The catalogue identifies these with the Hyundai Tucson, ix35, and Kia Sportage group. The remaining references, 44300-SNA-A02, 527202P000, and 8L8Z-1104-A, belong to the general wheel bearing listing and do not have published OE detail pages.

Vehicle Fitment

The catalogue lists Hyundai and Kia as the overall fitment brands. The more specific front hub records divide the applications into two groups. The Hyundai Elantra, Kia Cerato, and i30 group is associated with 51720-1G000, 51720-2H000, and 51720-A7000. These numbers should be checked together with the compact-model hub product specifications before inclusion in a quotation request.

The Hyundai Tucson, ix35, and Kia Sportage group is associated with 51720-2S000, 51720-3W000, and 51720-2B000. The corresponding product is identified as a front wheel hub bearing for SUV applications and is listed as compatible with 2WD and AWD. Those drive configurations do not remove the need to verify the complete OE number and hub configuration.

The general wheel bearing references are listed for Hyundai and Kia without a more specific model grouping in the supplied catalogue: 40210-ZP50A, 43550-42030, 44300-SNA-A02, 527202P000, and 8L8Z-1104-A. For a distributor order, these references should remain tied to the general wheel bearing product page rather than being moved into the Elantra, Cerato, i30, Tucson, ix35, or Sportage hub groups without additional verification.

Fitment matching should therefore operate at three levels: brand, named model, and complete OE number. A Hyundai designation alone is not enough to establish interchangeability, and two products serving the same brand may belong to different hub configurations. Keep the fitment record, OE number, and product specifications together in the purchasing file.

Pricing, MOQ and Lead Time

MOQ is 10 pieces per SKU. Pricing is FOB quotation on request, so the commercial offer should be prepared against a defined SKU and quantity rather than represented by a fixed unit price. Distributors planning mixed model coverage can identify the relevant OE numbers first, group them by product family, and request quotation lines for the quantities required under each SKU.

The quotation lead time is 1 business day. This is the stated lead time for a quotation and should not be interpreted as a stock statement or a shipment commitment. The catalogue does not confirm stock availability, so inventory status should not be inferred from the product listings or OE pages.

For an efficient request, provide the exact OE number, vehicle application, product family, required quantity, and destination if additional quotation information is requested. Examples include 51720-1G000 for the Hyundai Elantra, Kia Cerato, and i30 group or 51720-3W000 for the Hyundai Tucson, ix35, and Kia Sportage group. Keeping the request SKU-specific helps prevent ambiguity when one product page contains several cross-referenced numbers.

General bearing enquiries can use 43550-42030, 40210-ZP50A, 44300-SNA-A02, or 8L8Z-1104-A as the identifying reference. For the two hub-bearing groups, use the OE numbers assigned to the matching vehicle category. The quotation response can then be evaluated against the correct catalogue product rather than against a broadly described wheel bearing request.

Common Failure Signs

A worn or damaged wheel bearing may be associated with a hum that changes with vehicle speed, vibration during travel, or a grinding noise from the wheel area. These symptoms justify inspection, but they do not by themselves establish that the failed component is a general wheel bearing or a front hub bearing. The unit type and OE number must still be confirmed.

ABS-related warning indications can prompt a check of the integrated ABS ring, but the catalogue specifications differ between product groups. The general wheel bearing has an integrated ABS tone ring on Gen 3 units, while the compact-model hub bearing uses an integrated magnetic encoder ABS ring and the SUV hub bearing is listed with an integrated ABS ring. This difference matters when diagnosing or quoting a replacement.

Other inspection points include looseness, rough rotation, heat, damaged seals, contamination, corrosion, and play at the hub. A sealed-for-life or maintenance-free seal description does not mean the unit requires no inspection. It describes the listed seal configuration, not a claim that bearing defects cannot occur.

Moisture intrusion, impact damage, or incorrect installation can compromise a bearing even when its exterior appears clean. The best sourcing practice is to remove and inspect the existing unit, retain its identification markings, and compare the replacement configuration with the failed component before approving the order.

Quality Checklist

For incoming inspection, confirm that the package identification and physical bearing correspond to the ordered OE number. Check that no component has been dropped, damaged, or contaminated during handling. Protect the sealing surfaces and integrated ABS ring from impact during transport and unpacking.

Verify the product-specific construction against the catalogue. The general wheel bearing is listed as IP68 double-sealed, with factory-set preload and an integrated ABS tone ring on Gen 3 units. The Elantra, Cerato, and i30 front hub bearing is listed as double-row angular contact with an integrated magnetic encoder ABS ring, maintenance-free sealed construction, and high-temperature pre-filled grease.

For the Tucson, ix35, and Sportage front hub bearing, check the double-row angular contact design, integrated ABS ring, maintenance-free seal, and stated 2WD and AWD compatibility. The catalogue also records the OEM reference pair 51720-2S000 / 51720-3W000 for that product.

Finally, record the quantity received against the SKU MOQ of 10 pieces and compare the supplied number with the purchase order. If the received unit differs from the expected configuration, quarantine it for review and retain the packaging and identification details for the discrepancy record. A precise receiving process is especially important where several OE references are grouped under one product page.

FAQ

Which OE numbers are listed for the Hyundai and Kia wheel bearing catalogue?

The general wheel bearing product lists 43550-42030, 44300-SNA-A02, 40210-ZP50A, and 8L8Z-1104-A. The front hub bearing groups add 51720-1G000, 51720-2H000, 51720-A7000, 51720-2S000, 51720-3W000, and 51720-2B000. The catalogue also identifies 527202P000 as a wheel bearing reference.

Which front hub bearing group fits the Hyundai Elantra and Kia Cerato?

The Elantra, Cerato, and i30 group is associated with 51720-1G000, 51720-2H000, and 51720-A7000. The matching catalogue product is a front wheel hub bearing with a double-row angular contact design, integrated magnetic encoder ABS ring, maintenance-free seal, and high-temperature pre-filled grease.

Which front hub bearing group covers the Hyundai Tucson and Kia Sportage?

The Hyundai Tucson, ix35, and Kia Sportage group is associated with 51720-2S000, 51720-3W000, and 51720-2B000. The listed product is a front wheel hub bearing with an integrated ABS ring, maintenance-free seal, and stated compatibility with 2WD and AWD applications.

What is the minimum order quantity and quotation lead time?

MOQ is 10 pieces per SKU. Pricing is FOB quotation on request, and the quotation lead time is 1 business day. The catalogue does not confirm stock, so the quotation lead time should not be treated as a statement of availability or dispatch timing.

How should an OE number be checked before ordering?

Match the complete number, including all hyphens and letters, then confirm the product family, vehicle application, hub configuration, and listed specifications. The published OE pages can support the check for 40210-ZP50A, 43550-42030, 51720-1G000, 51720-2B000, 51720-2H000, 51720-2S000, 51720-3W000, and 51720-A7000.

Are the three wheel bearing product groups interchangeable?

The catalogue presents them as separate product groups: a general wheel bearing and two model-specific front hub bearing products. Although all are associated with Hyundai and Kia fitment, the design, ABS arrangement, seal description, and named applications differ. Cross-referencing should therefore include the complete OE number and vehicle group, not brand alone.
